title: The Tree of Life tarot spread
description: How the Tree of Life tarot spread works: ten cards on the Kabbalistic tree, what each position asks, and how to read it without studying Kabbalah.

scenes.headline: The Tree of Life tarot spread
scenes.caption: The Tree of Life tarot spread arranges ten cards on the Kabbalistic tree. Each position becomes a plain question, read from the practical present up to the highest aim.
scenes.vo: The Tree of Life tarot spread arranges ten cards on the Kabbalistic tree. Each position becomes a plain question, read from the practical present up to the highest aim.

scenes.headline: How the cards are laid out
scenes.caption: The tree has three vertical columns. Card 1 sits at the top centre, with 2 on the upper right and 3 on the upper left.
scenes.vo: How the cards are laid out. The tree has three vertical columns. Card 1 sits at the top centre, with 2 on the upper right and 3 on the upper left.

scenes.headline: The ten positions
scenes.caption: Each position carries a traditional Hebrew name, shown in brackets. The names are optional, and the questions are what you read from.
scenes.vo: The ten positions. Each position carries a traditional Hebrew name, shown in brackets. The names are optional, and the questions are what you read from.

scenes.caption: Photograph it and get a clear reading, card by card.
